title: BER: Fix some offset overflows
description:
Check if adding the reported length to the offset overflows when
computing the end offset of a SEQUENCE, SET, SEQUENCE OF, SET OF,
or BIT STRING.

Fix #20705. Fix #20713. Fix #20718.

notes.body: It would be superior in the long run to eliminate the end_offset variable and create a subset tvb instead, so that the exception is thrown as late as possible.
